DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM
LEADER: BRAWLY
“A big wave in fighting!”
translations.zh:
武斗镇宝可梦道馆
馆主：藤树
格斗的巨浪！

translations.label: DewfordTown_Text_HallSign
translations.original:
DEWFORD HALL
“Everyone's information exchange!”
translations.zh:
武斗集会所
大家交换信息的地方！

translations.label: DewfordTown_Text_TownSign
translations.original:
DEWFORD TOWN
“A tiny island in the blue sea.”
translations.zh:
武斗镇
蓝色大海中的小小岛屿。

translations.label: InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo
translations.original:
The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.

It's a POKéMON brand moving and
delivery service.
translations.zh: 箱子上印着宝可梦标志。这是宝可梦品牌的搬家与配送服务。

translations.label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BookTooHardToRead
translations.original: It's a book that's too hard to read.
translations.zh: 这是一本太深奥、读不懂的书。

translations.label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CrammedWithBooksOnPokemon
translations.original: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.
translations.zh: 里面塞满了关于宝可梦的书。

translations.label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PCUsedForResearch
translations.original:
It's a PC used for research.
Better not mess around with it.
translations.zh: 这是用于研究的电脑，还是不要乱动它为好。

translations.label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_SeriousLookingMachine
translations.original:
It's a serious-looking machine.
The PROF must use this for research.
translations.zh: 这台机器看起来很厉害，博士一定是用它来研究的。

translations.label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsLab
translations.original: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB
translations.zh: 小田卷博士的宝可梦研究所

translations.label: LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign
translations.original:
LITTLEROOT TOWN
“A town that can't be shaded any hue.”
translations.zh:
未白镇
“一座连色调都无法为其增色的城镇。”

translations.label: OldaleTown_Text_TownSign
translations.original:
OLDALE TOWN
“Where things start off scarce.”
translations.zh:
古辰镇
一切从稀少开始的地方。

translations.label: PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign
translations.original:
PETALBURG CITY
“Where people mingle with nature.”
translations.zh:
橙华市
人们与自然融为一体的城市。

PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM

橙华市宝可梦道馆

追求力量的男人！

translations.label: PetalburgCity_Text_WallyHouseSign
translations.original: WALLY'S HOUSE

translations.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
translations.original:
TRAINER TIPS

Any POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.

To raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
left of the team list.

As soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points without
being exposed to any harm.
translations.zh:
训练家提示
只要在对战中出场过一次，宝可梦就能获得经验值。想培养弱小的宝可梦，就把它放在队伍最前面，开战后立刻换下。这样既能获得经验，也能避免它受到伤害。

translations.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
translations.original:
TRAINER TIPS

In addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON
have Power Points (PP) that are used to
make moves during battle.

If a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be
taken to a POKéMON CENTER.
translations.zh:
训练家提示
除了体力，宝可梦使用招式还需要消耗招式点数PP。如果PP用完了，请带它去宝可梦中心恢复。

translations.label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ItsAGameCube
translations.original:
It's a Nintendo GameCube.

A Game Boy Advance is connected to
serve as the Controller.
translations.zh: 这是一台任天堂GameCube，连接了一台Game Boy Advance作为控制器。

translations.label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_Notebook
translations.original:
{PLAYER} flipped open the notebook.

ADVENTURE RULE NO. 1
Open the MENU with START.

ADVENTURE RULE NO. 2
Record your progress with SAVE.

The remaining pages are blank…
translations.zh:
{PLAYER}翻开了笔记本。
冒险守则第一条：按START打开菜单。
冒险守则第二条：使用“保存”记录进度。
其余的页面都是空白……

translations.label: Route101_Text_RouteSign
translations.original:
ROUTE 101
{UP_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN
translations.zh:
101号道路
↑ 古辰镇

translations.label: Route102_Text_RouteSignOldale
translations.original:
ROUTE 102
{RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN
translations.zh:
102号道路
→ 古辰镇

translations.label: Route102_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
translations.original:
ROUTE 102
{LEFT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY
translations.zh:
102号道路
← 橙华市

translations.label: Route103_Text_RouteSign
translations.original:
ROUTE 103
{DOWN_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN
translations.zh:
103号道路
↓ 古辰镇

translations.label: Route104_Text_MrBrineysCottage
translations.original: MR. BRINEY'S COTTAGE
translations.zh: 哈奇老人的小屋

translations.label: Route104_Text_PrettyPetalFlowShop
translations.original: PRETTY PETAL FLOWER SHOP
translations.zh: 漂亮花瓣花店

translations.label: Route104_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
translations.original:
ROUTE 1O4
{RIGHT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY
translations.zh:
104号道路
→ 橙华市

translations.label: Route104_Text_RouteSignRustboro
translations.original:
ROUTE 1O4
{UP_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY
translations.zh:
104号道路
↑ 卡那兹市

translations.label: Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles
translations.original:
TRAINER TIPS

In the HOENN region there are pairs
of TRAINERS who challenge others
for 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called
DOUBLE BATTLES.

In a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must
send out two POKéMON, the one at the
left of the list and the top one.
Watch how POKéMON are lined up.
translations.zh:
训练家提示
在丰缘，有两人一组的训练家会发起二对二的双打对战。双打时，队伍最前面的两只宝可梦会一起出场。请注意它们在队伍中的排列顺序。

translations.label: Route116_Text_RouteSignRustboro
translations.original:
ROUTE 116
{LEFT_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY
translations.zh:
116号道路
← 卡那兹市

translations.label: Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
translations.original:
RUSTURF TUNNEL
“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF

“The tunnel project has been
canceled.”
translations.zh:
卡绿隧道
连接卡那兹市与绿荫镇。
隧道工程已被取消。

translations.label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
translations.original:
TRAINER TIPS

If you want to stop a POKéMON from
evolving, press the B Button while it
is trying to evolve.
The startled POKéMON will stop.

This is called an evolution cancel.
translations.zh:
训练家提示
宝可梦正在进化时，如果想停止进化，就按B键。被吓到的宝可梦会停止进化。这叫作取消进化。

translations.label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
translations.original:
TRAINER TIPS

Your BAG has several POCKETS.

Items you obtain are automatically
placed in the appropriate POCKETS.

No TRAINER can afford to be without
a BAG of their own.
translations.zh:
训练家提示
背包里有多个口袋，获得的道具会自动放进对应的口袋。每位训练家都少不了自己的背包。

translations.label: Route116_Text_TunnelersRestHouse
translations.original: TUNNELER'S REST HOUSE
translations.zh: 隧道工人的休息小屋

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
translations.original:
Prototypes and test products fill
the glass display case.

There's a panel with a description…

“In addition to industrial products,
DEVON now markets sundries and
pharmaceuticals for better lifestyles.

“Recently, DEVON has begun marketing
tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including
POKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”
translations.zh:
玻璃柜里摆满了原型和试验产品，旁边有说明牌。
除了工业产品，得文现在也销售日用品和药品，让生活更加便利。最近还开始销售训练家工具，包括精灵球和宝可领航员系统。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
translations.original:
Samples of rocks and metal are
displayed in the glass case.

There's a panel with some writing
on it…

“DEVON CORPORATION got its start as
a producer of stones from quarries.

“The company also produced iron from
filings in the sand.

“From that humble start as a producer
of raw materials, DEVON developed.

“DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide
range of industrial products.”
translations.zh:
玻璃柜里展示着岩石与金属的样本，旁边有一块说明牌。
得文制造股份有限公司最初开采石料，也从砂中的铁屑提炼铁。从这家朴素的原料生产商起步，得文逐渐发展为生产各类工业产品的制造商。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocksDisplay
translations.original:
It's a collection of rare rocks and
stones assembled by the PRESIDENT.
translations.zh: 这是社长收集的稀有岩石和石头。

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
translations.original:
It's this student's notebook…

POKéMON are to be caught using
POKé BALLS.

Up to six POKéMON can accompany
a TRAINER.

A TRAINER is someone who catches
POKéMON, raises them, and battles
with them.

A TRAINER's mission is to defeat
the strong TRAINERS who await
challengers in POKéMON GYMS.
translations.zh:
这是学生的笔记本……
使用精灵球捕捉宝可梦。训练家可以带着最多六只宝可梦。训练家会捕捉、培养宝可梦，并与它们一起对战。训练家的使命，是打败在道馆里等待挑战者的强大训练家。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_CitySign
translations.original:
RUSTBORO CITY

“The city probing the integration of
nature and science.”
translations.zh:
卡那兹市
探索自然与科学融合的城市。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_CuttersHouse
translations.original: CUTTER'S HOUSE
translations.zh: 居合斩大师的家

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign
translations.original:
DEVON CORPORATION

“For all your living needs, we make
it all.”
translations.zh:
得文制造股份有限公司
满足生活所需，制造你需要的一切。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign
translations.original:
POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL

“We'll teach you anything about
POKéMON!”
translations.zh:
宝可梦训练家学校
关于宝可梦的一切，我们都会教你！

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletion
translations.original:
“Timesaving tunnel nearing
completion!”

…Is what it says on the sign, but
there's also a big “X” splashed
across it in red paint…
translations.zh:
节省时间的隧道即将完工！
……牌子上这样写着，不过上面还被红色油漆画了一个大大的叉……

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
translations.original:
It's a sample of beach sand.

“Stones from mountains are washed
down by rivers where they are
chipped and ground down.

“They are reduced to grains and end
up as sand on beaches.”
translations.zh:
这是海滩沙子的样本。
山上的石头被河流冲下来，不断碰撞、磨碎，变成颗粒，最后成为海滩上的沙子。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DepthMeasuringMachine
translations.original:
A strange machine is rotating under
a glass dome.

Maybe it's for measuring the depth
of something…
translations.zh: 一个奇怪的机器正在玻璃罩下旋转。也许是用来测量某种东西深度的……

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
translations.original:
It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it.

“Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured
by the tide.

“The flowing seawater marks the soil
with small ridges and valleys.

“If this soil becomes fossilized, it is
called a ripple mark.”
translations.zh:
这是一块带着波浪状纹路的化石。
潮汐冲刷海底的土壤，流动的海水留下细小的凸起和凹槽。这种土壤变成化石后，就叫作波痕。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
translations.original:
It's a sample of soil from the ocean
floor.

“Over many years, the remains of
life-forms settle at the bottom of
the sea, making sedimentary layers.

“By analyzing these layers, the
ancient past is revealed.”
translations.zh:
这是海底土壤的样本。
长年累月，生物的遗骸沉到海底，形成沉积层。分析这些地层，就能了解远古的过去。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
translations.original:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 1
Why is seawater blue?

“Light is composed of many colors.

“When light passes through water,
most kinds of light lose color.

“However, blue light retains its
color, making the sea appear blue.”
translations.zh:
海洋小知识一：海水为什么是蓝色的？
光由多种颜色组成。光穿过水时，大多数颜色会逐渐消失，但蓝色会保留下来，所以大海看起来是蓝色的。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
translations.original:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 2
Why is the sea salty?

“Seawater contains dissolved salt in
the form of sodium and chlorine ions.

“These ions leech out of rocks
and are carried out to sea by rain.

“The concentration of dissolved salt
makes the sea salty.”
translations.zh:
海洋小知识二：海水为什么是咸的？
海水中溶解着钠离子和氯离子等盐分。它们从岩石中溶出，由雨水带进大海。溶解盐分的浓度，让海水变咸。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
translations.original:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 3
Which is bigger? The sea or land?

“The sea covers about 70% of
the planet, and the rest is land.

“The sea is therefore more than twice
the size of land.”
translations.zh:
海洋小知识三：大海和陆地哪个更大？
大海覆盖了地球大约百分之七十的面积，其余是陆地。因此，大海的面积是陆地的两倍多。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WaterfallExperiment
translations.original:
A red ball is bobbing up and down
inside a glass vessel.

“This is an experiment simulating a
WATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”
translations.zh:
玻璃容器里的红色球上下浮动。
这是一项利用小球浮力模拟瀑布的实验。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WhirlpoolExperiment
translations.original:
A blue fluid is spiraling inside
a glass vessel.

“This is an experiment to create a
WHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”
translations.zh:
玻璃容器里的蓝色液体正在旋转。
这是一项利用风人工制造漩涡的实验。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DeepSeawaterDisplay
translations.original:
It's a display on the flow of seawater.

“Near the bottom of the sea, water
flows due to differences in such
factors as temperature and salinity.”
translations.zh:
这是介绍海水流动的展板。
海底附近，水因温度、盐度等因素的不同而流动。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_HoennModel
translations.original:
“MODEL OF HOENN REGION”

It's a miniature diorama of the
HOENN region.

Where is LITTLEROOT TOWN on this?
translations.zh:
丰缘地区模型
这是丰缘地区的缩小立体模型。未白镇在哪里呢？

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_PressureExperiment
translations.original:
A rubber ball is expanding and
shrinking.

“In the sea, the weight of water itself
exerts pressure.

“In shallow water, the pressure is not
very heavy.

“However, in extremely deep water,
the pressure can reach even tens of
thousands of tons on a small area.”
translations.zh:
一个橡胶球正在膨胀、收缩。
在海里，水本身的重量会产生压力。浅水处的压力不算大，但到了极深的海底，小小的一片面积可能承受数万吨的压力。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAnneReplica
translations.original:
“S.S. ANNE

“A replica of the luxury liner that
circles the globe.”
translations.zh:
圣安奴号
环游世界的豪华客轮的模型。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTidalReplica
translations.original:
“THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL

“A scale replica of the ship under
construction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”
translations.zh:
渡轮水静号
库斯诺吉造船厂正在建造的船舶的缩小模型。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SubmarineReplica
translations.original:
“SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1

“A replica of the high-performance
ocean floor exploration submarine.”
translations.zh:
潜水艇探险一号
高性能海底探测潜水艇的模型。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SumbersibleReplica
translations.original:
“SUBMERSIBLE POD

“A replica of a compact, unmanned
pod for seafloor exploration.”
translations.zh:
海底探测舱
用于探索海底的小型无人探测舱的模型。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SurfaceSeawaterDisplay
translations.original:
It's a display on the flow of seawater.

“Toward the surface, seawater flows
as currents driven by the winds.”
translations.zh:
这是介绍海水流动的展板。
海面附近，海水受风推动，以洋流的形式流动。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample1
translations.original:
“WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 1,” the
label says.

The sea is all connected, but the
water seems to differ by region.
translations.zh:
标签上写着：水质样本一。
大海相互连通，但不同地区的水似乎并不一样。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample2
translations.original:
“WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 2,” the
label says.

Does the saltiness of seawater differ
by region, too?
translations.zh:
标签上写着：水质样本二。
海水的咸度也会因地区而不同吗？

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentSign
translations.original:
BATTLE TENT SLATEPORT SITE
“Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”
translations.zh:
对战帐篷凯那会场
找到吧！最棒的宝可梦！

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_CitySign
translations.original:
SLATEPORT CITY

“The port where people and POKéMON
cross paths.”
translations.zh:
凯那市
人们与宝可梦相遇的港口。

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_MarketSign
translations.original:
SLATEPORT MARKET
“Unique items found nowhere else!”
translations.zh:
凯那集市
出售别处找不到的独特商品！

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_NameRatersHouseSign
translations.original:
NAME RATER'S HOUSE
“POKéMON nicknames rated.”
translations.zh:
姓名鉴定师的家
鉴定宝可梦的昵称。

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_OceanicMuseumSign
translations.original:
“The endless sea sustains
all life.”

OCEANIC MUSEUM
translations.zh:
无边的大海孕育着所有生命。
海洋科学博物馆

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign
translations.original:
POKéMON FAN CLUB
“Calling all fans of POKéMON!”
translations.zh:
宝可梦同好会
欢迎所有宝可梦爱好者！

translations.label: gText_PokemartSign
translations.original:
“Selected items for your convenience!”
POKéMON MART
translations.zh:
为你的旅途精选便利道具！
友好商店

translations.label: gText_PokemonCenterSign
translations.original:
“Rejuvenate your tired partners!”
POKéMON CENTER
translations.zh:
让疲惫的伙伴重焕精神！
宝可梦中心
